name: K3s
description: K3s is a lightweight, fully conformant Kubernetes distribution in a single binary. This VM runs a server node ready to join agents.

notes.text: Cloud-Init sets up credentials, SSH keys and networking. If you turn it off on Debian, root logs in on the console without a password, so set one right away.
ArgoCD is installed on first boot by default. Set INSTALL_ARGOCD_BOOTSTRAP=0 to skip it.
If you use Cloud-init, checkout cloud-init discussion: `https://github.com/community-scripts/ProxmoxVE/discussions/272`
